world_news_real.description: Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.

world_news_real.title: Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak

world_news_real.title: Autopsy shows Hayden Panettiere died from a drug overdose
world_news_real.description: The death of the child star - who had fentanyl, Xanax, a muscle relaxant and antipsychotic medication in her system -  was ruled an accident.

world_news_real.title: Veteran BBC Africa correspondent Mark Doyle dies aged 67
world_news_real.description: Doyle was best known for reporting on African conflicts in the 1990s and 2000s, notably in Rwanda and Sierra Leone.

world_news_real.title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly

world_news_real.title: Outrage in India over viral video of teen molested and her friend beaten
world_news_real.description: Three minors were arrested after videos capturing the assault went viral in India, sparking anger.

world_news_real.title: Doctor in court to face Rwanda genocide charges in UK
world_news_real.description: Dr Vincent Brown was charged following a seven year British investigation into the 1994 killings.
